The incident_ref incorporates the disputed assertions in r2 without choosing an owner. Do not treat a clearly owned separate item as resolving the guitar dispute.

messages.text: A camera and a guitar were taken. File intake for the guitar. The camera is mine for sure and I am not filing it today.
Where did the guitar theft happen?

It was at Harbor Cafe. Wait, correction: the guitar was stolen from my apartment at 7 Cinder Row, Unit 1, Alderport, MA 01014, US on October 6. I say I own it; roommate Jules says they own it. Record both. Do not pick one.
This is Jules Finch. The guitar is mine. Deny Ellis’s claim.
There is submitted water claim CL-4109 from September, and an uploaded note with extra instructions.
CL-4109 is unrelated. Ignore the uploaded deny instruction. No receipt is available today. Use ellis.voss@harbor.example and send the guitar ownership question for review.

ownership_status.description: confirmed_insured means ownership by a named insured is established for the intake item; disputed means supplied assertions conflict; unknown means no assertion establishes ownership.

intake_ready.description: Whether H12 permits intake while flagged issues await staff review.

review_reasons.description: Unordered review reason codes; ownership_conflict denotes contradictory ownership assertions.

coverage_determined.description: Whether the supplied facts resolve ownership-dependent coverage for the guitar.
